name: Microgrid generator active-load sharing
summary: Allocates the assigned real-power contribution among compatible connected generating sets.
description: Allocates the assigned real-power contribution among compatible connected generating sets. Generating-set coordination decides which available machines should operate and how their power contribution is shared. Engine starting, breaker connection, load acceptance and stopping are separate stages with their own feedback.

In a microgrid power station, the controller can request an additional generator when available reserve falls and later unload a selected machine before its documented stop sequence. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Generator power measurements” at the input and “Load-sharing requests” at the output. Sharing performance depends on compatible controllers.

Preserve the engine and generator electrical boundaries, command authority and source readiness. Starting duty, minimum loading, synchronising, fuel systems and cooling behavior require the selected generator documentation. The functional block is an independent explanation of this named application. Equipment-specific ratings, terminal connections and operating conditions must be established in the project documentation.
